items.title: 17.12 RLC series circuit se AC (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 17.12, Example 17.7 and an extra resonance example of ours (PDF 102-104).

blocks.text: Ek RLC series circuit lein jis ka AC source ki frequency badli ja sakti hai (Fig. 17.11(a)). Is ka impedance diagram Fig. 17.11(b) mein hai, jahan inductive reactance X_L = ωL aur capacitive reactance X_C = 1/ωC ek doosre ki opposite direction (ulti simt) mein hain (ek upar, ek neeche).

blocks.alt: (a) AC source ke saath series mein R, L aur C, current I. Saath teen chhote graph: R ke liye Vo aur Io aik saath; L ke liye Vo quarter cycle aage; C ke liye Vo quarter cycle peeche. Ghoomta phasor daira XL ko +90 degree aur XC ko -90 degree par, 180 degree ke farq se dikhata. (b) Impedance tikon ABC: AB par R, BC par XL - XC, AC par Z, angle theta.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.11 (a), (b): (a) RLC series circuit aur us ka phasor diagram; (b) RLC series circuit ka impedance vector diagram (kitab ki Figure 17.11 (a), (b) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: X_L aur X_C ek doosre ki ulti direction (simt) mein hain (ek +90°, doosri −90°), is liye un ka farq X_L − X_C hi R ke saath milta hai: Z = √(R² + (X_L − X_C)²). X_L bari ho to circuit RL jaisa, X_C bari ho to RC jaisa.
Zyada frequency par X_L = ωL, X_C = 1/ωC se bohat bari hoti hai; inductive reactance X_L dominant (ghalib) hoti hai aur circuit RL series circuit jaisa behave (bartao) karta hai.
Kam frequency par X_C = 1/ωC, X_L = ωL se bohat bari hoti hai; capacitive reactance X_C dominant hoti hai aur circuit RC series circuit jaisa behave karta hai (Fig. 17.11(b)).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab in do jumlon mein X_L ko 'inductance' aur X_C ko 'capacitance' kehti hai. Sahi: X_L inductive reactance aur X_C capacitive reactance hai (dono ohm mein); inductance L aur capacitance C alag cheezein hain.
In dono ke darmiyan ek frequency ωᵣ aati hai jis par X_L = X_C. Is halat mein RLC series circuit sirf resistor (R) wale circuit jaisa ban jata hai (Fig. 17.11(c)).

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text: Neeche ceiling fan ki wiring ki tasveer hai (live wire, switch, running winding, capacitor ke saath starting winding, rotor) aur poochti hai: ceiling fan mein kaunsa AC circuit istemal hota hai?

blocks.alt: Ceiling fan ki wiring: live wire ON/OFF switch se guzarti hai; oopar wali wire mein running winding (stator) hai jo daen taraf se neeche neutral wire tak aati hai; doosri branch mein capacitor aur starting winding (stator) neeche neutral wire tak; beech mein rotor; aik teer single phase supply dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Brain teaser: ceiling fan ki wiring (kitab ki tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.prompt: Brain teaser ka jawab: ceiling fan mein kaunsa AC circuit hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Capacitor-start (split-phase) motor circuit. Starting winding ke saath series mein capacitor laga hai, is liye us ka current running winding ke current se phase mein aage khisak jata hai. Do windings ke alag phase wale currents mil kar rotating (ghoomta hua) magnetic field banate hain jo rotor ko ghumata hai.

blocks.text: Is condition (halat) ko resonance kehte hain. Resonance par X_L aur X_C barabar aur opposite direction mein hain, is liye ek doosre ko cancel (khatam) kar deti hain. Resonance frequency fᵣ is condition se milti hai:

blocks.alt: (c) Aik horizontal teer R: XL = XC par sirf resistance bachti hai. (d) Current I aur frequency f: resonance frequency fr par tez peak, peak par dashed lakeer, axis se peak tak dohra teer aur dono taraf horizontal teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.11 (c), (d): (c) XL = XC par RLC series circuit sirf resistance ki tarah; (d) XL = XC par resonance (kitab ki Figure 17.11 (c), (d) ke mutabiq original drawing).
